source_refs.note: v) Inter-particle forces in solids: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: In solids, the particles (atoms, ions, molecules) are held together by ionic, covalent, metallic or van der Waals forces. These forces are strong enough to fix the particles at their places thus allowing these particles to just vibrate about their mean positions.
